headline: Catawba go top having conceded three goals all season
dek: Catawba's win at Tusculum on Sunday took them past Emory & Henry and Anderson to the top of the conference table. They are unbeaten after six wins and two draws, with twenty-four scored and three conceded. Anderson and Emory & Henry have not lost either, and Catawba do not meet Anderson until the middle of October.
displaced_by: Catawba's win at Tusculum takes them top of the conference table; the standing dek's match in hand no longer holds

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-four and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Every side in the conference has now won at least once; Lenoir-Rhyne's first came at Newberry on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tusculum's defeat at home to Catawba on Sunday was their fourth of the season, against one win and one draw, and they have scored four goals in all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry are unbeaten with two wins and two draws, nine scored and four conceded, and go to Mars Hill on Tuesday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne's win at Newberry on Saturday was their first of the season: one win, three draws and five defeats, twelve scored and twenty-one conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made thirty-three saves and conceded seven goals.

last_match.line: Catawba go top of the conference table still unbeaten; Tusculum have not won since early September.

next_match.line: Emory & Henry have yet to lose; Mars Hill were beaten at Carson-Newman on Saturday.
